title.en: Which payment methods do you accept?

answer.es: Aceptamos tarjetas de crédito y débito (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), transferencia bancaria y PayPal. Para planes empresariales ofrecemos facturación.
answer.en: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), bank transfer and PayPal. Invoicing is available for enterprise plans.
